# Stageshow runtime

Generated from the repository's MIT-licensed Stageshow kit. Only Stage, Window, Row, Badge and their dependencies ship in index.js; Roll ships alone in roll.js, so a page that only rolls a figure does not load the stage. Source and notices live under .claude/skills/stageshow. Rebuild from frontend with node scripts/build-stageshow.mjs. Do not edit generated files. Product scenes and styling live beside this directory.
